specs.title: Add a product to the empty basket from the product list

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Click `Add to Basket` on Eggfruit Juice (500ml)
3. Open the basket with the button `Your Basket`
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button in the row of product A
3. Click the minus button in the row of product A
4. Click the minus button in the row of product A again
5. Click the trash button in the row of product A

specs.title: A normal customer cannot put more than the purchase limit of a product into the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list and add Apple Juice (1000ml) to the basket
2. Open the basket and click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Open the product list and add Apple Juice (1000ml) to the basket again

specs.title: Login with a wrong password fails and with the right password opens the shop

steps.title: Precondition: create a customer account, nobody is logged in
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: Pay with the wallet only when the balance covers the order total

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, check out and continue with the saved address
2. Select `Standard Delivery` and continue
3. Read the button `Pay`
4. Open `Order History` from the account menu
5. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card
6. Check out again with `Standard Delivery`
7. Click `Pay`
8. Click `Place your order and pay`
9. Open `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
10. Open `Order History` from the account menu
